security_audit.summary: The audit confirms a critical pipe-to-shell installer on SKILL.md line 26. It also confirms user-driven Higgsfield CLI execution and remote processing of prompts and image references. Most Markdown backtick and placeholder URL detections were false positives.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to the shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell installation with a verified package, checksum validation, or explicit manual install steps.

remediation.issue: Commands are built from user-provided prompts, paths, and context.
remediation.suggestion: Use argument arrays, validate enumerated flags, quote paths safely, and reject shell metacharacters in free text.

remediation.issue: Product images and listing context are processed by a remote backend.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear consent step before uploading local assets or sensitive product information.

content.value_statement: Marketplace listings need consistent product visuals across main images, infographics, lifestyle shots, and A+ modules. This skill routes clear listing intent to Higgsfield CLI workflows that generate ready image URLs.
actual_capabilities: Selects main, product-images, aplus, or full-set scopes for marketplace image generation.
Builds Higgsfield marketplace-cards create commands from product and listing intent.
Passes optional product images, upload IDs, brand context, category, and visual style.
Supports custom asset subsets with repeated asset selections.
Returns labeled image URLs for generated marketplace cards.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI to be installed and authenticated before generation.
Sends prompts and supplied image references to Higgsfield services.
Does not create generic brand photoshoots, video ads, or character training assets.
Does not expose backend prompt templates or internal model details.

use_cases.title: Launch a Marketplace Listing
use_cases.description: Create a main image, secondary images, and A+ modules from one product image and listing brief.

use_cases.title: Expand Product Detail Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate infographics, multi-angle views, detail shots, and lifestyle images for an existing listing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Review Assets
use_cases.description: Produce labeled marketplace image concepts that clients can review before a listing update.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Main Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Create one compliant main listing image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a main marketplace image for my insulated water bottle. Use ./bottle.jpg and keep the style clean and premium.

prompt_templates.title: Product Image Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create product images for a peach lemonade can using ./can.png. Include lifestyle, detail, and infographic visuals for a beverage listing.

prompt_templates.title: Full Listing System
prompt_templates.scenario: Create the full marketplace bundle with brand context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full marketplace image set for a clinical skincare serum. Use ./serum.jpg, a minimal white and sage brand style, and category skincare.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced A+ Modules
prompt_templates.scenario: Use an existing main image job for selected A+ assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my completed main job to create A+ feature, efficacy, how-to-use, and endorsement modules for the same supplement product.

best_practices: Provide a clear product image or upload ID whenever possible.
State the required scope before generation to avoid extra assets.
Include brand context, category, and visual style when they affect the listing.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for generic product photography without listing context.
Do not request hidden backend prompt templates or internal model details.
Do not include sensitive customer data in product context or images.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates marketplace main images, secondary product visuals, and A+ style content modules through Higgsfield.

faq.question: Does it need a product image?
faq.answer: A product image is preferred. Clear text or a product URL can work when the product details are specific.

faq.question: Can it create a full listing image set?
faq.answer: Yes. The full-set scope creates a main image, five secondary images, and seven A+ modules.

faq.question: Can I request only selected image types?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports custom asset selections for specific marketplace cards.

faq.question: Does it reveal enhanced prompts?
faq.answer: No. Backend enhancement owns marketplace rules and prompt templates.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The Higgsfield CLI must be installed, available on the path, and authenticated.
